title: Column customer stories
description: One large near-white card with a row of customer-name tabs along its top: the chosen one fills with that customer's accent colour. Below, a 28px navy statement, small grey product chips and a pull quote with its author sit on the left, the customer's art on the right; switching tabs crossfades both. On phones the stories become a swipeable row of cards, art on top with the name over it, the next card peeking in.
notes: needs JavaScript for the desktop tabs (hydrate: visible); the phone carousel is plain CSS scroll-snap
each story has its own accent (tone) and media slot; empty, the art is a soft wash of that accent with a faint dot grid and a plain card frame
